description: tonyd2wild's regular Inkling Small profile on two Sparks: thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small-NVFP4 on vLLM tensor parallel 2 (mp, as eugr's launcher does by default) with Inkling's native one-token MTP drafter, InstantTensor loading, a 262,144-token context, BF16 KV cache (upstream: FP8 and NVFP4 KV are hardware-capable but the Inkling relative-attention kernel cannot consume them yet) and CUDA graphs. Image: eugr's published spark-vllm image (digest-pinned, built from eugr/spark-vllm-docker 60dee5b4), with upstream's mods applied at build time: eugr's inkling-sm12-paged-kv (vendored FA4 SM120 kernel) and instanttensor-hybrid-draft-loader, and tonyd2wild's inkling-agent-parser-fix (filters a leaked terminal end-of-message marker after tool results). eugr's launch-cluster.sh at 60dee5b4 also exports NCCL_IGNORE_CPU_AFFINITY=1 and PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True into every container (lines 10-11), and the recipe sets both, as the creator's verified runs had them. Same-creator alternative for this model and Spark count: the DSpark recipe with the RadixArk draft. Licences (information only): model Apache-2.0; eugr's runtime and mods MIT with a bundled FA4 package under its own licence; tonyd2wild's repository states that no licence has been selected. Upstream measurements are in its results document and are claims until measured here; Vonk physical two-Spark acceptance is pending. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. Measured peak (hardware sweep 2026-10-31T04:51:54Z, run alone, Controller node telemetry, OS included): entrypoint 120,668,758,016 and worker 119,059,685,376 bytes in use (a single post-smoke sample, so a lower bound of the steady peak); the declared peaks are the in-use bytes less the 2 GiB OS allowance, never lower than before: entrypoint 118,521,274,368, worker 116,912,201,728.
title: Inkling Small NVFP4 MTP vLLM two Sparks (tonyd2wild)
